<thought>We need to generate an ML-ready dataset from the consolidated polymorphs JSON using advanced feature engineering, a 0.2 test split, and normalization. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will create the necessary train and test files under the specified output path. After running it, we will create a metadata JSON file that lists the feature names and the paths to the train and test CSV files, then return the path to this metadata file.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_0/consolidated_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_0/nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
